text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Components

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Signatures

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: There are two signatures: the provincial signature

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: (Symbol and provincial logotype), and the mini-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: sterial signature (provincial signature and ministry

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: name). All vehicles must carry both signatures

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: for side and rear marking.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Unit Number

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: All vehicles and equipment must carry a unit

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: number on the sides and rear.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Reflective Striping

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Trucks, trailers, and any vehicles operating under

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: particularly hazardous conditions must carry reflec-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: tive striping.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Size

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Both signatures are divided into several sizes.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Complete details are found on facing page.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Numbers are only two sizes, 2” and 4” high.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Reflective Striping: the length of strip needed

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: varies with size of vehicle. Detailed dimensions of

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: striping on opposite page.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Colour

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: There are two colour choices only for provincial

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: signature and number markings: white or black.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: White markings are to be used against all colours

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: except white or near-white where black is preferable.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Reflective striping must be white and yellow only.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Materials

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: The markings will consist of individual letters,

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: numbers and the Provincial Symbol die-cut and

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: pre-spaced on a carrier tape. They are highly

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: readable and easily applied. Reflectorized striping

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: comes as rolls that can be cut to required lengths.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Forty-eight (48) hours after application, it will be

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: impossible to remove the marking without destroy-

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: ing it. The film material used in the markings will

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: have an exterior life expectancy of seven (7) years.

text.font-family: ManualKit Helvetica, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Helvetica, Nimbus Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Province of British Columbia Visual Identity Program
